mapper.select: SELECT "lbs"."rosen_bus_stop_id" AS "stop_id" , "lbs"."ride_alight_division" AS "boarding_type" , "lbs"."rosen_id" , "lbs"."sequence_no" FROM "line_bus_stops" AS "lbs" INNER JOIN "lines" AS "l" ON "l"."del_flag" = 0 AND "l"."business_corp_id" = CAST(#{businessCorpId} AS INTEGER) AND "l"."available_flag" = 1 AND "l"."rosen_id" = "lbs"."rosen_id" INNER JOIN "charge_revisions" AS "rc" ON "rc"."del_flag" = 0 AND "rc"."charge_revision_id" = CAST(#{chargeRevisionId} AS INTEGER) AND "rc"."rosen_id" = "l"."rosen_id" INNER JOIN "bus_stops" AS "bs" ON "bs"."del_flag" = 0 AND "bs"."bus_stop_id" = "lbs"."bus_stop_id" WHERE "lbs"."del_flag" = 0 ORDER BY "lbs"."rosen_id" ASC , "lbs"."sequence_no" ASC

SELECT "lbs_to"."rosen_bus_stop_id" AS "stop_id" , "lbs_to"."sequence_no" AS "sequence_no" FROM "line_bus_stops" AS "lbs_from" INNER JOIN "line_bus_stops" AS "lbs_to" ON "lbs_to"."del_flag" = 0 AND "lbs_to"."ride_alight_division" > 0 AND "lbs_to"."rosen_id" = "lbs_from"."rosen_id" AND "lbs_to"."sequence_no" > "lbs_from"."sequence_no" WHERE "lbs_from"."del_flag" = 0 AND "lbs_from"."ride_alight_division" <> 1 AND "lbs_from"."rosen_id" = CAST(#{rosenId} AS INTEGER) AND "lbs_from"."rosen_bus_stop_id" = CAST(#{fromStopId} AS INTEGER)
